export function Notices({u}){const n=useCol('notices',['uid','==',u.uid]);const[a,setA]=useState({});const[busy,run]=useBusy()
if(!n.length)return null
const L=[...n].sort((x,y)=>(y.t?.seconds||0)-(x.t?.seconds||0))
const sub=(x,e)=>{e.preventDefault();run(async()=>{await updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{answers:x.qs.map((_,i)=>a[x.id]?.[i]||''),status:'answered'});toast('Answers sent')})}
return <div style={{marginTop:24}}><h3>🔔 Notifications <span className="tag r">{L.filter(x=>x.status==='sent').length} new</span></h3>
<div className="grid" style={{marginTop:12}}>{L.map(x=><div key={x.id} className={'card '+(x.status==='sent'?'glow':'')}><span className="tag">{x.kind==='questionnaire'?'📋 Widget questionnaire':'🔔 Reminder'}</span><p style={{margin:'8px 0'}}>{x.text}</p>
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status==='sent'&&<form onSubmit={e=>sub(x,e)} style={{maxWidth:'none'}}>{x.qs.map((q,i)=><input key={i} required placeholder={q} value={a[x.id]?.[i]||''} onChange={e=>setA({...a,[x.id]:{...a[x.id],[i]:e.target.value}})}/>)}<button disabled={busy}>Submit answers</button></form>}
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status!=='sent'&&x.qs.map((q,i)=><p key={i} style={{fontSize:13}}><small>{q}</small><br/>{x.answers[i]}</p>)}
{x.kind==='reminder'&&(x.status==='sent'?<button className="s" onClick={()=>updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{status:'done'})}>Mark as done</button>:<span className="tag">done</span>)}</div>)}</div></div>}

export function Notices({u}){const n=useCol('notices',['uid','==',u.uid]);const[a,setA]=useState({});const[busy,run]=useBusy()
if(!n.length)return null
const L=[...n].sort((x,y)=>(y.t?.seconds||0)-(x.t?.seconds||0))
const sub=(x,e)=>{e.preventDefault();run(async()=>{await updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{answers:x.qs.map((_,i)=>a[x.id]?.[i]||''),status:'answered'});toast('Answers sent')})}
return <div style={{marginTop:24}}><h3>🔔 Notifications <span className="tag r">{L.filter(x=>x.status==='sent').length} new</span></h3>
<div className="grid" style={{marginTop:12}}>{L.map(x=><div key={x.id} className={'card '+(x.status==='sent'?'glow':'')}><span className="tag">{x.kind==='questionnaire'?'📋 Widget questionnaire':'🔔 Reminder'}</span><p style={{margin:'8px 0'}}>{x.text}</p>
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status==='sent'&&<form onSubmit={e=>sub(x,e)} style={{maxWidth:'none'}}>{x.qs.map((q,i)=><input key={i} required placeholder={q} value={a[x.id]?.[i]||''} onChange={e=>setA({...a,[x.id]:{...a[x.id],[i]:e.target.value}})}/>)}<button disabled={busy}>Submit answers</button></form>}
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status!=='sent'&&x.qs.map((q,i)=><p key={i} style={{fontSize:13}}><small>{q}</small><br/>{x.answers[i]}</p>)}
{x.kind==='reminder'&&(x.status==='sent'?<button className="s" onClick={()=>updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{status:'done'})}>Mark as done</button>:<span className="tag">done</span>)}</div>)}</div></div>}

const gait=ph=>{ph=((ph%1)+1)%1;if(ph<.5)return{x:STR/2-STR*(ph/.5),y:0};const t=(ph-.5)/.5;return{x:-STR/2+STR*(1-cos(PI*t))/2,y:.09*sin(PI*t)}}
const _e=new THREE.Euler(),_q=new THREE.Quaternion(),_q2=new THREE.Quaternion(),_a=V(),_b=V(),_c=V(),_p=V(),_dn=V(0,-1,0)

export function createJourney(host,api){
const {getP,visible,onStation,onFail,reduced}=api
let renderer
try{renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,powerPreference:'high-performance'})}catch{return null}
const geos=[],mats=[],texs=[]
const mob=()=>host.clientWidth<760
let dpr=min(devicePixelRatio||1,mob()?1.5:2),lost=false
renderer.setPixelRatio(dpr);renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.05
host.appendChild(renderer.domElement)
const onLost=e=>{e.preventDefault();lost=true;if(onFail)onFail()}
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('webglcontextlost',onLost)
const BG=0x090b11,scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color(BG);scene.fog=new THREE.Fog(BG,14,mob()?46:68)
const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(40,1,.1,120),env=getEnv()
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xbfc8ff,0x0a0b10,.9))
const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,2.1);scene.add(sun,sun.target)

// ---------- helpers ----------
const mk=o=>{const m=new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({envMap:env,envMapIntensity:1,side:THREE.DoubleSide,...o});mats.push(m);return m}
const GL=()=>{const m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:ACC,emissive:ACC,emissiveIntensity:1.6,roughness:.4});mats.push(m);return m}
const SH=mk({color:0xf1f3fa,metalness:.2,roughness:.22,clearcoat:1,clearcoatRoughness:.08})
const DK=mk({color:0x1b1e29,metalness:.8,roughness:.32,clearcoat:.5})
const MID=mk({color:0x2b3040,metalness:.6,roughness:.4})
const add=(g,m,x,y,z,par)=>{geos.push(g);const o=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);o.position.set(x,y,z);par.add(o);return o}
const rb=(w,h,d,r,m,x,y,z,par)=>add(new RoundedBoxGeometry(w,h,d,3,min(r,min(w,h,d)/2)),m,x,y,z,par)
const cy=(a,b,h,m,x,y,z,par)=>add(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(a,b,h,22),m,x,y,z,par)
const sp=(r,m,x,y,z,par)=>add(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r,18,14),m,x,y,z,par)
const bx=(w,h,d,m,x,y,z,par)=>add(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),m,x,y,z,par)
const tex=(w,h,draw)=>{const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;const x=c.getContext('2d');draw(x,w,h);const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;texs.push(t);return{t,redraw:(...a)=>{draw(x,w,h,...a);t.needsUpdate=true}}}

// ---------- road path (arc-length parametrised) ----------
const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(PTS.map(p=>V(...p)),false,'centripetal');curve.arcLengthDivisions=1500
const L=curve.getLength()
const pt=u=>curve.getPointAt(cl(u))
const fr=u=>{const p=pt(u),t=curve.getTangentAt(cl(u)),h=V(t.x,0,t.z).normalize();return{p,h,yaw:atan2(h.x,h.z),l:V(h.z,0,-h.x),r:V(-h.z,0,h.x)}}
const N=mob()?260:420,samp=[];for(let i=0;i<=N;i++)samp.push(fr(i/N))
const sweep=(segs,m)=>{const pos=[],idx=[];segs.forEach(s=>{const base=pos.length/3
 for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const f=samp[i];for(let j=0;j<2;j++){const[lat,y]=s[j];pos.push(f.p.x+f.l.x*lat,f.p.y+y,f.p.z+f.l.z*lat)}}
 for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const a=base+i*2;idx.push(a,a+1,a+2,a+1,a+3,a+2)}})
 const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));g.setIndex(idx);g.computeVertexNormals();geos.push(g);const o=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);scene.add(o);return o}
const roadM=mk({color:0x20242f,metalness:.25,roughness:.55}),curbM=mk({color:0x12141c,metalness:.5,roughness:.5})
const lineM=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:ACC,side:THREE.DoubleSide});mats.push(lineM)
sweep([[[HW,0],[-HW,0]]],roadM)
sweep([[[HW,0],[HW-.04,-.3]],[[-HW+.04,-.3],[-HW,0]]],curbM)
sweep([[[HW-.06,.012],[HW-.14,.012]],[[-HW+.14,.012],[-HW+.06,.012]]],lineM)

// ---------- world ----------
const ground=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(400,400),mk({color:0x0b0d14,metalness:0,roughness:1}));geos.push(ground.geometry);ground.rotation.x=-PI/2;ground.position.set(0,-.72,50);scene.add(ground)
const grid=new THREE.GridHelper(300,150,0x2a3140,0x2a3140);grid.material.transparent=true;grid.material.opacity=.4;grid.position.set(0,-.71,50);scene.add(grid);geos.push(grid.geometry);mats.push(grid.material)
const dm=new THREE.Object3D()
const lampN=mob()?10:18
const poleG=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.03,.03,1.5,8),headG=new THREE.SphereGeometry(.09,10,8);geos.push(poleG,headG)
const poles=new THREE.InstancedMesh(poleG,DK,lampN),heads=new THREE.InstancedMesh(headG,lineM,lampN);scene.add(poles,heads)
for(let i=0;i<lampN;i++){const f=fr(.03+.95*i/(lampN-1));dm.position.copy(f.p).addScaledVector(f.l,HW+.35);dm.position.y+=.75;dm.updateMatrix();poles.setMatrixAt(i,dm.matrix);dm.position.y+=.8;dm.updateMatrix();heads.setMatrixAt(i,dm.matrix)}
const NB=mob()?36:72,bg=new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);geos.push(bg)
const boxes=new THREE.InstancedMesh(bg,mk({color:0x151a26,metalness:.35,roughness:.6,envMapIntensity:.5}),NB);scene.add(boxes)
let placed=0,guard=0
while(placed<NB&&guard++<3000){const x=(Math.random()-.5)*90,z=-12+Math.random()*130;let dmin=1e9
 for(let i=0;i<samp.length;i+=8)dmin=min(dmin,hypot(samp[i].p.x-x,samp[i].p.z-z))
 if(dmin<8)continue
 const w=1.5+Math.random()*3.5,h=1+Math.random()*8,d=1.5+Math.random()*3.5
 dm.position.set(x,-.72+h/2,z);dm.scale.set(w,h,d);dm.updateMatrix();boxes.setMatrixAt(placed++,dm.matrix)}
boxes.count=placed;dm.scale.set(1,1,1)

// ---------- stations (each with its own purposeful action) ----------
const d0=D=>{
 rb(.9,.7,.5,.04,DK,0,.38,0,D);const top=rb(.9,.06,.5,.025,SH,0,.76,.02,D);top.rotation.x=-.18
 const bm=GL(),btn=cy(.1,.1,.05,bm,0,.82,.08,D),gm=GL()
 const bars=[-.3,0,.3].map(x=>rb(.1,1.5,.1,.04,gm,x,1,-.25,D))
 const sg=tex(512,128,(x,w,h)=>{x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);x.fillStyle='#b9f45c';x.font='bold 88px sans-serif';x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';x.fillText('KELVORA',w/2,h/2)})
 const sm=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:sg.t,transparent:true,opacity:.2,depthWrite:false});mats.push(sm)
 add(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.8,.45),sm,0,2.55,-.25,D)
 return w=>{const reach=ss(.08,.26,w)*(1-ss(.74,.9,w)),press=ss(.36,.43,w)*(1-ss(.5,.57,w)),res=ss(.46,.72,w)
  btn.position.y=.82-.03*press;bm.emissiveIntensity=1.2+2*press+res
  bars.forEach((b,i)=>{const k=max(.03,ss(.46+i*.04,.68+i*.04,w));b.scale.y=k;b.position.y=.8+.75*k});gm.emissiveIntensity=.25+1.6*res;sm.opacity=.15+.85*res
  return{rT:D.localToWorld(V(0,lerp(.98,.88,press),.12)),rW:reach,look:D.localToWorld(V(0,lerp(.9,2.3,res),lerp(.1,-.25,res))),lookW:ss(.3,.45,w)*(1-ss(.9,1,w)),lean:.1*reach}}}

const d1=D=>{
 bx(.8,.05,.5,MID,.25,.03,0,D);cy(.05,.06,.75,DK,.25,.42,-.1,D);rb(1.5,.95,.07,.03,DK,.25,1.2,-.1,D)
 const T=tex(512,320,(x,w,h,scan=0,res=0)=>{x.fillStyle='#0b0d14';x.fillRect(0,0,w,h);x.fillStyle='#161a26';x.fillRect(0,0,w,44);x.fillStyle='#b9f45c';x.font='bold 22px sans-serif';x.textAlign='left';x.textBaseline='middle';x.fillText('AUDIT',18,23)
  ;[['HTTPS secure',1],['Mobile friendly',1],['Chatbot',0],['Online booking',0]].forEach(([n,ok],i)=>{const y=80+i*52;x.fillStyle='#2a2f40';x.fillRect(18,y-20,w-36,40);x.fillStyle='#e7e9f3';x.font='20px sans-serif';x.fillText(n,32,y);if(scan>(i+.6)/5){x.fillStyle=ok?'#b9f45c':'#ff6b82';x.fillText(ok?'OK':'MISSING',w-130,y)}})
  x.fillStyle='rgba(185,244,92,.9)';x.fillRect(0,50+scan*230,w,3)
  if(res>.5){x.fillStyle='#b9f45c';x.font='bold 28px sans-serif';x.fillText('Gaps found: 2',18,h-30)}})
 const sm=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:T.t});mats.push(sm);add(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.4,.86),sm,.25,1.2,-.06,D)
 let lastK=-1
 return w=>{const reach=ss(.1,.26,w)*(1-ss(.84,.95,w)),scan=ss(.22,.68,w),res=ss(.66,.8,w),k=floor(scan*28)+floor(res*6)*100
  if(k!==lastK){lastK=k;T.redraw(scan,res)}
  return{rT:D.localToWorld(V(.25+.2*sin(scan*PI*3),lerp(1.4,1,scan),.14)),rW:reach,look:D.localToWorld(V(.25,1.2,-.06)),lookW:reach,lean:.12*reach}}}

const d2=D=>{
 const gm=GL(),cm=GL();cm.emissiveIntensity=.8
 rb(.7,.95,.46,.04,SH,-.15,.52,-.04,D);rb(.34,.05,.26,.02,DK,-.05,1.02,0,D);bx(.5,.04,.02,gm,-.15,.9,.2,D)
 const gg=new THREE.Group();gg.position.set(-.15,.65,.2);D.add(gg);const gc=cy(.17,.17,.04,DK,0,0,0,gg);gc.rotation.x=PI/2
 for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const a=i*PI/3;bx(.05,.06,.04,gm,cos(a)*.19,sin(a)*.19,0,gg)}
 rb(.4,.62,.34,.03,DK,.55,.35,.05,D);rb(.34,.04,.28,.02,MID,.55,.68,.05,D)
 rb(.1,.1,.1,.03,cm,.45,.75,.05,D);rb(.1,.1,.1,.03,cm,.65,.75,.05,D)
 const cube=rb(.1,.1,.1,.03,cm,.55,.76,.05,D),orb=sp(.09,gm,-.05,1.3,.05,D)
 const binP=V(.55,.76,.05),slotH=V(-.05,1.25,.05),slotIn=V(-.05,1.04,.05)
 return w=>{const drop=ss(.56,.64,w),vanish=ss(.6,.68,w),on=ss(.62,.78,w),ob=ss(.74,.95,w)
  const hand=new THREE.Vector3(),cp=new THREE.Vector3()
  if(w<.28){hand.copy(binP);hand.y+=lerp(.4,.1,ss(.08,.2,w))}
  else if(w<.56){const t=ss(.28,.5,w);hand.copy(binP).lerp(slotH,t);hand.y+=.1+sin(t*PI)*.2-.1*ss(.5,.56,w)}
  else{hand.copy(slotH)}
  if(w<.28)cp.copy(binP);else if(w<.56){cp.copy(hand);cp.y-=.1}else{cp.set(slotH.x,slotH.y-.1,slotH.z);cp.lerp(slotIn,drop)}
  cube.position.copy(cp);cube.scale.setScalar(max(.001,1-vanish))
  gg.rotation.z=-8*ss(.6,1,w);gm.emissiveIntensity=.3+1.7*on
  orb.visible=ob>.01;orb.scale.setScalar(max(.01,ob));orb.position.set(-.05,1.3+.55*ob,.05)
  const c=ss(.06,.16,w)*(1-ss(.3,.4,w))
  return{rT:D.localToWorld(hand),rW:ss(.04,.14,w)*(1-ss(.62,.82,w)),look:D.localToWorld(w<.56?cp.clone():V(-.05,1.3+.55*ob,.05)),lookW:ss(.04,.14,w)*(1-ss(.9,1,w)),crouch:.2*c,lean:.16*c}}}

const d3=D=>{
 const gm=GL()
 rb(.9,.7,.44,.04,SH,.15,.39,0,D);cy(.14,.15,.04,DK,.45,.76,.1,D)
 const kg=new THREE.Group();kg.position.set(.45,.8,.1);D.add(kg);cy(.11,.11,.08,SH,0,0,0,kg);bx(.02,.012,.09,gm,0,.045,.03,kg)
 const HH=[.25,.4,.6,.8,1.05],bars=HH.map((h,i)=>rb(.09,1,.09,.03,gm,-.2+.1*i,.74+h/2,-.12,D))
 const arrow=add(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.06,.15,12),gm,.2,2,-.12,D)
 return w=>{const turn=ss(.22,.72,w),ang=turn*PI*1.5,res=ss(.7,.9,w)
  kg.rotation.y=-ang
  bars.forEach((b,i)=>{const k=max(.03,ss(.24+.06*i,.62+.05*i,w));b.scale.y=HH[i]*k;b.position.y=.74+HH[i]*k/2})
  const k4=ss(.48,.86,w);arrow.visible=k4>.95;arrow.position.y=.74+HH[4]*k4+.14;gm.emissiveIntensity=.4+1.4*ss(.3,.8,w)
  return{rT:D.localToWorld(V(.45+cos(ang)*.07,.93,.1+sin(ang)*.07)),rW:ss(.08,.2,w)*(1-ss(.8,.92,w)),lT:D.localToWorld(V(-.45,1.45,.15)),lW:res*(1-ss(.94,1,w)),look:D.localToWorld(V(-.05,1.2,-.1)),lookW:ss(.3,.5,w)*(1-ss(.92,1,w)),lean:.06}}}

const d4=D=>{
 const rm=GL(),dm2=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:ACC,transparent:true,opacity:0,side:THREE.DoubleSide,depthWrite:false});mats.push(dm2)
 add(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.95,.05,14,64),rm,.2,1.3,-.15,D);add(new THREE.CircleGeometry(.9,40),dm2,.2,1.3,-.16,D)
 rb(.14,.5,.14,.04,DK,-.85,.3,-.15,D);rb(.14,.5,.14,.04,DK,1.25,.3,-.15,D)
 return w=>{const k=ss(.38,.62,w);rm.emissiveIntensity=.4+1.9*k;dm2.opacity=.5*k
  return{rT:D.localToWorld(V(lerp(.05,.65,ss(.2,.5,w)),1.22+.03*sin(w*9),.12)),rW:ss(.1,.24,w),lookCam:true,lookW:ss(.62,.8,w),faceCam:ss(.66,.85,w)*.7,lean:.03}}}

const builders=[d0,d1,d2,d3,d4]
const devs=U.map((u,i)=>{const f=fr(u),sd=sg(i),D=new THREE.Group();D.position.copy(f.p).addScaledVector(f.r,DEV_LAT*sd);D.rotation.y=f.yaw+sd*PI/2;scene.add(D)
 rb(1.7,.08,.9,.03,MID,0,0,0,D);const fn=builders[i](D);D.updateMatrixWorld(true);return fn})

// ---------- Chimpuk (articulated, procedural) ----------
const RG=GL()
const root=new THREE.Group(),pelvis=new THREE.Group();root.add(pelvis);scene.add(root)
rb(.34,.14,.22,.05,DK,0,0,0,pelvis)
const torso=new THREE.Group();torso.position.y=.08;pelvis.add(torso)
rb(.4,.42,.27,.1,SH,0,.23,0,torso);rb(.2,.05,.02,.01,RG,0,.27,.14,torso);rb(.3,.08,.2,.04,DK,0,.44,0,torso)
const head=new THREE.Group();head.position.y=.57;torso.add(head)
rb(.44,.33,.36,.13,SH,0,0,0,head);rb(.36,.2,.05,.02,DK,0,.01,.175,head)
const eyes=[-1,1].map(s=>{const e=add(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(.025,.07,4,8),RG,s*.085,.015,.205,head);e.rotation.z=PI/2;return e})
cy(.012,.012,.14,DK,0,.23,0,head);sp(.03,RG,0,.31,0,head)
const mkArm=sx=>{const sh=new THREE.Group();sh.position.set(sx*.25,.37,0);torso.add(sh);sp(.07,DK,0,0,0,sh);rb(.09,.32,.09,.04,SH,0,-.15,0,sh)
 const el=new THREE.Group();el.position.y=-.3;sh.add(el);sp(.05,DK,0,0,0,el);rb(.08,.3,.08,.035,SH,0,-.14,0,el)
 const hand=new THREE.Group();hand.position.y=-.28;el.add(hand);sp(.065,DK,0,0,0,hand);sp(.025,RG,0,-.03,.04,hand);return{sh,el,hand,sx}}
const arms=[mkArm(1),mkArm(-1)]
const mkLeg=sx=>{const hip=new THREE.Group();hip.position.set(sx*.1,-.02,0);pelvis.add(hip);sp(.06,DK,0,0,0,hip);rb(.1,.32,.1,.045,SH,0,-.15,0,hip)
 const knee=new THREE.Group();knee.position.y=-T1;hip.add(knee);sp(.05,DK,0,0,0,knee);rb(.09,.32,.09,.04,SH,0,-.15,0,knee)
 const ankle=new THREE.Group();ankle.position.y=-T2;knee.add(ankle);const foot=new THREE.Group();ankle.add(foot);rb(.14,.07,.26,.03,DK,0,-.035,.05,foot);bx(.1,.012,.1,RG,0,-.068,.1,foot)
 return{hip,knee,foot}}
const legs=[mkLeg(1),mkLeg(-1)]
const sc=document.createElement('canvas');sc.width=sc.height=128
{const x=sc.getContext('2d'),g=x.createRadialGradient(64,64,0,64,64,64);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.6)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,128,128)}
const shT=new THREE.CanvasTexture(sc);texs.push(shT)
const blobM=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:shT,transparent:true,depthWrite:false});mats.push(blobM)
const blob=add(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(.9,.9),blobM,0,0,0,scene);blob.rotation.x=-PI/2

const legSolve=(lg,tz,ty)=>{const dist=hypot(tz,ty),d=min(max(dist,.15),T1+T2-.003),k=dist>0?d/dist:1;tz*=k;ty*=k
 const th=atan2(tz,-ty),A=acos(cl((T1*T1+d*d-T2*T2)/(2*T1*d),-1,1)),t1=th+A
 const kz=T1*sin(t1),ky=-T1*cos(t1),t2=atan2(tz-kz,-(ty-ky))
 lg.hip.rotation.x=-t1;lg.knee.rotation.x=t1-t2;lg.foot.rotation.x=t2}
const arm=(a,swing,T,w)=>{const sh=a.sh,el=a.el
 _q.setFromEuler(_e.set(swing,0,a.sx*.09));_q2.setFromEuler(_e.set(-.3,0,0))
 if(!T||w<.001){sh.quaternion.copy(_q);el.quaternion.copy(_q2);return}
 const d=_b.copy(torso.worldToLocal(_a.copy(T))).sub(sh.position);let D=d.length();const R=LU+LF-.01
 if(D>R){d.multiplyScalar(R/D);D=R}
 if(D<.15){d.copy(_dn).multiplyScalar(.15);D=.15}
 const dir=_c.copy(d).normalize(),aa=(LU*LU-LF*LF+D*D)/(2*D),hh=sqrt(max(0,LU*LU-aa*aa))
 _p.set(a.sx*.8,-.5,-.35);_p.addScaledVector(dir,-_p.dot(dir)).normalize()
 const e=V().copy(dir).multiplyScalar(aa).addScaledVector(_p,hh)
 const qs=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(_dn,e.clone().normalize())
 const f=d.clone().sub(e).applyQuaternion(qs.clone().invert()).normalize()
 const qe=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(_dn,f)
 sh.quaternion.copy(_q).slerp(qs,w);el.quaternion.copy(_q2).slerp(qe,w)}

// ---------- journey state: pose is a pure function of scroll progress ----------
const sideOf=u=>{if(u>=U[4])return sg(4);let i=0;while(i<3&&u>=U[i+1])i++;const t=cl((u-U[i])/(U[i+1]-U[i]));return lerp(sg(i),sg(i+1),ss(.35,.65,t))}
const state=q=>{const g=TL.s;let u=U[0]-E,pres=0,act=q<g[0].a?0:-1,sd=1
 for(const x of g){if(q<x.a||q>x.b)continue;const t=(q-x.a)/(x.b-x.a),e=t*t*(3-2*t)
  if(x.k!=='t')sd=sg(x.i)
  if(x.k==='w'){u=U[x.i];pres=1;act=x.i}
  else{u=lerp(x.u0,x.u1,e);if(x.k==='t'){pres=0;act=-1}else if(x.k==='a'){pres=e;act=(e>.5||x.i===0)?x.i:-1}else{pres=1-e;act=e<.5?x.i:-1}}}
 if(q>g[g.length-1].b){u=U[4];pres=1;act=4;sd=sg(4)}
 return{u,pres,act,sd}}

let ps=0,first=true,lastAct=-2,lastDist=0,lastYaw=0,ph=0,W=0,yaw=0,roll=0
const camP=V(),camL=V()
const frame=(dt,t)=>{
 const kk=r=>1-exp(-dt*r)
 let p=getP()
 if(reduced){let bi=0,bd=9;TL.w.forEach((g,i)=>{const d=abs(p*TL.total-(g.a+g.b)/2);if(d<bd){bd=d;bi=i}});const g=TL.w[bi];p=(g.a+.85*(g.b-g.a))/TL.total;ps=p}
 else ps=first?p:ps+(p-ps)*kk(9)
 const q=ps*TL.total,s=state(q)
 if(s.act!==lastAct){lastAct=s.act;if(onStation)onStation(s.act)}
 const outs=devs.map((fn,i)=>fn(cl((q-TL.w[i].a)/(TL.w[i].b-TL.w[i].a))))
 const out=(s.act>=0&&outs[s.act])||{}
 const f=fr(s.u),pres=s.pres,sd=s.sd
 root.position.copy(f.p).addScaledVector(f.r,ROB_LAT*pres*sd)
 const dist=s.u*L,dd=first?0:dist-lastDist;lastDist=dist
 W+=((reduced?0:(abs(dd)/max(dt,.001)>.12?1:0))-W)*kk(10)
 ph+=cl(dd,-1.5,1.5)/(2*STR)

export function Notices({u}){const n=useCol('notices',['uid','==',u.uid]);const[a,setA]=useState({});const[busy,run]=useBusy()
if(!n.length)return null
const L=[...n].sort((x,y)=>(y.t?.seconds||0)-(x.t?.seconds||0))
const sub=(x,e)=>{e.preventDefault();run(async()=>{await updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{answers:x.qs.map((_,i)=>a[x.id]?.[i]||''),status:'answered'});toast('Answers sent')})}
return <div style={{marginTop:24}}><h3>🔔 Notifications <span className="tag r">{L.filter(x=>x.status==='sent').length} new</span></h3>
<div className="grid" style={{marginTop:12}}>{L.map(x=><div key={x.id} className={'card '+(x.status==='sent'?'glow':'')}><span className="tag">{x.kind==='questionnaire'?'📋 Widget questionnaire':'🔔 Reminder'}</span><p style={{margin:'8px 0'}}>{x.text}</p>
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status==='sent'&&<form onSubmit={e=>sub(x,e)} style={{maxWidth:'none'}}>{x.qs.map((q,i)=><input key={i} required placeholder={q} value={a[x.id]?.[i]||''} onChange={e=>setA({...a,[x.id]:{...a[x.id],[i]:e.target.value}})}/>)}<button disabled={busy}>Submit answers</button></form>}
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status!=='sent'&&x.qs.map((q,i)=><p key={i} style={{fontSize:13}}><small>{q}</small><br/>{x.answers[i]}</p>)}
{x.kind==='reminder'&&(x.status==='sent'?<button className="s" onClick={()=>updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{status:'done'})}>Mark as done</button>:<span className="tag">done</span>)}</div>)}</div></div>}

const {getP,visible,onStation,onFail,reduced}=api
let renderer
try{renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,powerPreference:'high-performance'})}catch{return null}
const geos=[],mats=[],texs=[]
const mob=()=>host.clientWidth<760
/*q-low*/const LOWQ=(navigator.hardwareConcurrency||8)<=4||(navigator.deviceMemory||8)<=4;let dpr=min(devicePixelRatio||1,LOWQ?1:mob()?1.5:2),lost=false
renderer.setPixelRatio(dpr);renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;renderer.toneMappingExposure=.92

const onLost=e=>{e.preventDefault();lost=true;if(onFail)onFail()}

const BG=0xece8e0,scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color(BG);scene.fog=new THREE.Fog(BG,14,mob()?46:68)
const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(40,1,.1,120),env=getEnv()

// ---------- helpers ----------

const GL=()=>{const m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:ACC,emissive:ACC,emissiveIntensity:1.6,roughness:.4});mats.push(m);return m}

const rb=(w,h,d,r,m,x,y,z,par)=>add(new RoundedBoxGeometry(w,h,d,3,min(r,min(w,h,d)/2)),m,x,y,z,par)
const cy=(a,b,h,m,x,y,z,par)=>add(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(a,b,h,22),m,x,y,z,par)

// ---------- road path (arc-length parametrised) ----------
const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(PTS.map(p=>V(...p)),false,'centripetal');curve.arcLengthDivisions=1500
const L=curve.getLength()
const pt=u=>curve.getPointAt(cl(u))
const fr=u=>{const p=pt(u),t=curve.getTangentAt(cl(u)),h=V(t.x,0,t.z).normalize();return{p,h,yaw:atan2(h.x,h.z),l:V(h.z,0,-h.x),r:V(-h.z,0,h.x)}}
const N=mob()?400:680,samp=[];for(let i=0;i<=N;i++)samp.push(fr(i/N))
const sweep=(segs,m)=>{const pos=[],idx=[];segs.forEach(s=>{const base=pos.length/3
 for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const f=samp[i];for(let j=0;j<2;j++){const[lat,y]=s[j];pos.push(f.p.x+f.l.x*lat,f.p.y+y,f.p.z+f.l.z*lat)}}
 for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const a=base+i*2;idx.push(a,a+1,a+2,a+1,a+3,a+2)}})
 const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));g.setIndex(idx);g.computeVertexNormals();geos.push(g);const o=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);scene.add(o);return o}
const roadM=mk({color:0xa3abb4,metalness:0,roughness:.9}),curbM=mk({color:0x9d978b,metalness:0,roughness:.8})

sweep([[[HW,0],[-HW,0]]],roadM)
sweep([[[HW,0],[HW-.04,-.3]],[[-HW+.04,-.3],[-HW,0]]],curbM).visible=false;
sweep([[[HW-.06,.012],[HW-.14,.012]],[[-HW+.14,.012],[-HW+.06,.012]]],lineM).visible=false;

// ---------- world ----------
const ground=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(700,700),mk({color:0xffffff,map:(()=>{const f=tex(128,128,(x,w,h)=>{x.fillStyle='#e6e1d7';x.fillRect(0,0,w,h);x.strokeStyle='#dcd6ca';x.lineWidth=2;x.strokeRect(0,0,w,h)});f.t.wrapS=f.t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;f.t.repeat.set(233,233);return f.t})(),metalness:0,roughness:.9}));geos.push(ground.geometry);ground.rotation.x=-PI/2;ground.position.set(0,-.05,100);scene.add(ground)

/*shell*/{const WL=mk({color:0xf1eee7,metalness:0,roughness:.9}),BS=mk({color:0xb7ae9e,metalness:0,roughness:.8}),CE=mk({color:0xf8f6f1,metalness:0,roughness:1})

 bx(BW,1.1,.34,BS,cx,.55,Z0,scene);bx(BW,1.1,.34,BS,cx,.55,Z1,scene);bx(.34,1.1,BD,BS,X0,.55,cz,scene);bx(.34,1.1,BD,BS,X1,.55,cz,scene)

// bench-props
{const BM=mk({color:0xb99b74,metalness:0,roughness:.6}),BL=mk({color:0x2b3040,metalness:.3,roughness:.5})

  bx(.5,.07,1.4,BM,0,.45,0,G);bx(.5,.35,.07,BM,sd*.22,.7,0,G);[[-.2,-.6],[-.2,.6],[.2,-.6],[.2,.6]].forEach(([x,z])=>bx(.06,.45,.06,BL,x,.22,z,G))}}}
{const pG=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.4,.32,.6,14),lG=new THREE.SphereGeometry(.6,14,10);geos.push(pG,lG)

  dm.position.copy(f.p).addScaledVector(f.l,sd*(HW+.9));dm.position.y+=.3;dm.rotation.set(0,0,0);dm.scale.set(1,1,1);dm.updateMatrix();pot.setMatrixAt(n,dm.matrix)

 return w=>{const reach=ss(.08,.26,w)*(1-ss(.74,.9,w)),press=ss(.36,.43,w)*(1-ss(.5,.57,w)),res=ss(.46,.72,w)
  btn.position.y=.82-.03*press;bm.emissiveIntensity=1.2+2*press+res
  bars.forEach((b,i)=>{const k=max(.03,ss(.46+i*.04,.68+i*.04,w));b.scale.y=k;b.position.y=.8+.75*k});gm.emissiveIntensity=.25+1.6*res;sm.opacity=.15+.85*res
  return{rT:D.localToWorld(V(0,lerp(.98,.88,press),.12)),rW:reach,look:D.localToWorld(V(0,lerp(.9,2.3,res),lerp(.1,-.25,res))),lookW:ss(.3,.45,w)*(1-ss(.9,1,w)),lean:.1*reach}}}

  cube.position.copy(cp);cube.scale.setScalar(max(.001,1-vanish))

import {useState,useEffect} from 'react'
const get=()=>{try{return localStorage.getItem('kv_theme')||'auto'}catch{return 'auto'}}
const eff=m=>m==='auto'?(matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches?'light':'dark'):m
export const apply=m=>{const t=eff(m);document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;document.querySelector('meta[name=theme-color]')?.setAttribute('content',t==='light'?'#f5f6fb':'#090a10')}
export function useTheme(){const[m,setM]=useState(get);const[t,setT]=useState(()=>eff(get()))
useEffect(()=>{apply(m);setT(eff(m));if(m!=='auto')return;const q=matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)');const f=()=>{apply('auto');setT(eff('auto'))};q.addEventListener('change',f);return()=>q.removeEventListener('change',f)},[m])
const toggle=()=>{const n=t==='light'?'dark':'light';try{localStorage.setItem('kv_theme',n)}catch{};setM(n)}
return[t,toggle]}

async function groq(messages){for(const model of [E.GROQ_MODEL||'openai/gpt-oss-120b','llama-3.3-70b-versatile','llama-3.1-8b-instant']){

async function scout(req){const fs=FS();let jid

const q=await quota(fs,user,adm);if(q)return{status:429,body:{error:q}}
await fs.create('scouts',jid,{uid:user.uid,email:user.email,input,status:'running',step:'Starting…',createdAt:new Date()})
let sources=[],snips=[],sig=null,pages=[],domain=''

export function Notices({u}){const n=useCol('notices',['uid','==',u.uid]);const[a,setA]=useState({});const[busy,run]=useBusy()

{x.kind==='reminder'&&(x.status==='sent'?<button className="s" onClick={()=>updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{status:'done'})}>Mark as done</button>:<span className="tag">done</span>)}</div>)}</div></div>}

export function makeRobot(color){

export function Notices({u}){const n=useCol('notices',['uid','==',u.uid]);const[a,setA]=useState({});const[busy,run]=useBusy()
if(!n.length)return null

const sub=(x,e)=>{e.preventDefault();run(async()=>{await updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{answers:x.qs.map((_,i)=>a[x.id]?.[i]||''),status:'answered'});toast('Answers sent')})}
return <div style={{marginTop:24}}><h3>🔔 Notifications <span className="tag r">{L.filter(x=>x.status==='sent').length} new</span></h3>

{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status==='sent'&&<form onSubmit={e=>sub(x,e)} style={{maxWidth:'none'}}>{x.qs.map((q,i)=><input key={i} required placeholder={q} value={a[x.id]?.[i]||''} onChange={e=>setA({...a,[x.id]:{...a[x.id],[i]:e.target.value}})}/>)}<button disabled={busy}>Submit answers</button></form>}
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status!=='sent'&&x.qs.map((q,i)=><p key={i} style={{fontSize:13}}><small>{q}</small><br/>{x.answers[i]}</p>)}
{x.kind==='reminder'&&(x.status==='sent'?<button className="s" onClick={()=>updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{status:'done'})}>Mark as done</button>:<span className="tag">done</span>)}</div>)}</div></div>}

import {useState,useEffect} from 'react'
import {useParams,useNavigate,Link} from 'react-router-dom'

export function Notices({u}){const n=useCol('notices',['uid','==',u.uid]);const[a,setA]=useState({});const[busy,run]=useBusy()
if(!n.length)return null
const L=[...n].sort((x,y)=>(y.t?.seconds||0)-(x.t?.seconds||0))
const sub=(x,e)=>{e.preventDefault();run(async()=>{await updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{answers:x.qs.map((_,i)=>a[x.id]?.[i]||''),status:'answered'});toast('Answers sent')})}
return <div style={{marginTop:24}}><h3>🔔 Notifications <span className="tag r">{L.filter(x=>x.status==='sent').length} new</span></h3>
<div className="grid" style={{marginTop:12}}>{L.map(x=><div key={x.id} className={'card '+(x.status==='sent'?'glow':'')}><span className="tag">{x.kind==='questionnaire'?'📋 Widget questionnaire':'🔔 Reminder'}</span><p style={{margin:'8px 0'}}>{x.text}</p>
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status==='sent'&&<form onSubmit={e=>sub(x,e)} style={{maxWidth:'none'}}>{x.qs.map((q,i)=><input key={i} required placeholder={q} value={a[x.id]?.[i]||''} onChange={e=>setA({...a,[x.id]:{...a[x.id],[i]:e.target.value}})}/>)}<button disabled={busy}>Submit answers</button></form>}
{x.kind==='questionnaire'&&x.status!=='sent'&&x.qs.map((q,i)=><p key={i} style={{fontSize:13}}><small>{q}</small><br/>{x.answers[i]}</p>)}
{x.kind==='reminder'&&(x.status==='sent'?<button className="s" onClick={()=>updateDoc(doc(db,'notices',x.id),{status:'done'})}>Mark as done</button>:<span className="tag">done</span>)}</div>)}</div></div>}

export function getEnv(){
if(ENV)return ENV

const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);g.addColorStop(0,'#34345c');g.addColorStop(.5,'#12121f');g.addColorStop(1,'#06060d');x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,w,h)
const cs=['#ffffff','#b6ff5c','#ffffff','#7c5cff','#ffffff','#22d3ee','#ffffff','#ff4fa3']

const P=o=>new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({envMap:getEnv(),envMapIntensity:1.5,...o})
export function makeRobot(color){
const g=new THREE.Group()
const shell=P({color:0xeef1fa,metalness:.18,roughness:.2,clearcoat:1,clearcoatRoughness:.05})
const graph=P({color:0x16171f,metalness:.9,roughness:.26,clearcoat:.8,clearcoatRoughness:.1})
const glass=P({color:0x03030a,metalness:1,roughness:.03,clearcoat:1,clearcoatRoughness:.02})
const glow=P({color,emissive:color,emissiveIntensity:2.2,roughness:.3,metalness:0,envMapIntensity:.4})
const add=(geo,mat,x=0,y=0,z=0,p=g)=>{const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);m.position.set(x,y,z);p.add(m);return m}
const sp=(r,a,b,c)=>new THREE.SphereGeometry(r,48,32).scale(a,b,c)
const body=new THREE.Group();g.add(body)
add(sp(.8,1,1.15,.62),shell,0,.15,0,body)
add(sp(.5,1,.75,.35),graph,0,.45,.4,body)
const ring=add(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.21,.03,12,48,Math.PI*1.5),glow,0,.45,.6,body)
add(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.29,.012,8,64),glow,0,.45,.59,body)
add(new THREE.CircleGeometry(.1,32),glow,0,.45,.595,body)
add(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.56,.025,.02),glow,0,.02,.5,body)
add(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.4,.32,.3,36),graph,0,-.85,0,body)
add(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.42,.16,.8,40),shell,0,-1.35,0,body)
add(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.2,.2,.04,32),glow,0,-1.78,0,body)
add(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.3,.014,8,48).rotateX(Math.PI/2),glow,0,-1.74,0,body)
add(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.28,.5,32,1,true),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color,transparent:true,opacity:.18,side:THREE.DoubleSide,depthWrite:false}),0,-2.05,0,body).rotation.x=Math.PI
add(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.18,.22,.3,24),graph,0,1.12,0,body)
const head=new THREE.Group();head.position.set(0,1.55,0);g.add(head)
const skull=add(sp(.62,1,.88,.92),shell,0,0,0,head)
add(sp(.5,1.05,.62,.5),glass,0,.02,.4,head)
const eyes=[-.2,.2].map(x=>add(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(.03,.11,4,12).rotateZ(Math.PI/2),glow,x,.02,.64,head))

export default function SceneHost(){

  try{off=localStorage.getItem('kv_3d')==='off'}catch{}

  bus.el=host.current;if(bus.on)host.current.style.display='block'

Reply with JSON only: {"summary":"2-3 sentences what they do","confidence":"high|medium|low","founders":[{"name":"","role":"","source":"url from search"}],"software_gaps":[""],"marketing_gaps":[""],"recommendations":[{"service":"","why":"","priority":"high|medium|low","when":"Week 1|Month 1|Month 2-3"}],"agents":[{"name":"","does":"","saves_est":"","build_time":""}],"partners":[{"id":"","why":"","how":"","when":""}],"plan":[{"when":"","what":""}],"pitch":"2 friendly sentences for a sales call"}
Limits: 5 recommendations, 4 agents, 3 partners, 5 plan steps, 4 gaps per list.`
let E,JWKS,JT=0,AT,AX=0
const enc=new TextEncoder(),dec=new TextDecoder()
const b64u=s=>Uint8Array.from(atob(s.replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0))
const b64s=b=>btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(b))).replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'')
const RS={name:'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',hash:'SHA-256'}

async function verify(tok,pid){const[h,p,s]=tok.split('.');if(!s)throw new Error('Please sign in again')
const hd=JSON.parse(dec.decode(b64u(h))),pl=JSON.parse(dec.decode(b64u(p)))
if(!JWKS||Date.now()-JT>36e5){JWKS=(await(await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/service_accounts/v1/jwk/securetoken@system.gserviceaccount.com')).json()).keys;JT=Date.now()}
const k=JWKS.find(x=>x.kid===hd.kid);if(!k||hd.alg!=='RS256')throw new Error('Invalid session')
const key=await crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk',k,RS,false,['verify'])
if(!await crypto.subtle.verify('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',key,b64u(s),enc.encode(h+'.'+p)))throw new Error('Invalid session')
if(pl.aud!==pid||pl.iss!=='https://securetoken.google.com/'+pid||pl.exp<Date.now()/1e3||!pl.sub)throw new Error('Session expired. Please sign in again.')
return{uid:pl.sub,email:pl.email,verified:pl.email_verified}}

async function access(sa){if(AT&&Date.now()<AX)return AT
const now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1e3),h=b64s(enc.encode(JSON.stringify({alg:'RS256',typ:'JWT'}))),p=b64s(enc.encode(JSON.stringify({iss:sa.client_email,scope:'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datastore',aud:'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',iat:now,exp:now+3600})))
const der=Uint8Array.from(atob(sa.private_key.replace(/-----[^-]+-----|\s/g,'')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0))
const key=await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8',der,RS,false,['sign'])
const sig=b64s(await crypto.subtle.sign('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',key,enc.encode(h+'.'+p)))
const r=await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},body:'grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion='+h+'.'+p+'.'+sig})
const j=await r.json();if(!j.access_token)throw new Error('Database auth failed');AT=j.access_token;AX=Date.now()+3e6;return AT}

const fv=v=>v===null||v===undefined?{nullValue:null}:v instanceof Date?{timestampValue:v.toISOString()}:typeof v==='boolean'?{booleanValue:v}:typeof v==='number'?(Number.isInteger(v)?{integerValue:String(v)}:{doubleValue:v}):typeof v==='string'?{stringValue:v}:Array.isArray(v)?{arrayValue:{values:v.map(fv)}}:{mapValue:{fields:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k,x])=>[k,fv(x)]))}}
const uv=f=>{if('stringValue'in f)return f.stringValue;if('integerValue'in f)return Number(f.integerValue);if('doubleValue'in f)return f.doubleValue;if('booleanValue'in f)return f.booleanValue;if('timestampValue'in f)return new Date(f.timestampValue);if('arrayValue'in f)return(f.arrayValue.values||[]).map(uv);if('mapValue'in f)return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(f.mapValue.fields||{}).map(([k,x])=>[k,uv(x)]));return null}
function FS(){const sa=JSON.parse(E.FIREBASE_SA),base=`https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${sa.project_id}/databases/(default)/documents`
const call=async(url,m='GET',body)=>{const r=await fetch(url,{method:m,headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+await access(sa),'content-type':'application/json'},body:body&&JSON.stringify(body)});if(r.status===404&&m==='GET')return null;if(!r.ok)throw new Error('DB '+r.status+' '+(await r.text()).slice(0,100));return r.json()}
const fields=o=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).map(([k,v])=>[k,fv(v)]))
const parse=d=>({id:d.name.split('/').pop(),...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.fields||{}).map(([k,x])=>[k,uv(x)]))})
return{pid:sa.project_id,
get:async p=>{const d=await call(`${base}/${p}`);return d?parse(d):null},
create:(c,id,o)=>call(`${base}/${c}?documentId=${id}`,'POST',{fields:fields(o)}),
update:(p,o)=>call(`${base}/${p}?`+Object.keys(o).map(k=>'updateMask.fieldPaths='+encodeURIComponent(k)).join('&'),'PATCH',{fields:fields(o)}),
set:(p,o)=>call(`${base}/${p}`,'PATCH',{fields:fields(o)}),
query:async(c,f,lim)=>{const q={from:[{collectionId:c}],limit:lim};if(f)q.where={fieldFilter:{field:{fieldPath:f[0]},op:'EQUAL',value:fv(f[1])}};return(await call(`${base}:runQuery`,'POST',{structuredQuery:q})).filter(x=>x.document).map(x=>parse(x.document))}}}

const bad=h=>/^(localhost|.*\.local|.*\.internal)$/i.test(h)||/^[\d.]+$/.test(h)||h.includes(':')||h.startsWith('[')
async function get(url,hops=0){const u=new URL(url);if(!/^https?:$/.test(u.protocol)||bad(u.hostname)||(u.port&&!['80','443'].includes(u.port)))throw new Error('Blocked link')
const r=await fetch(u.href,{redirect:'manual',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(8000),headers:{'user-agent':UA,accept:'text/html,text/plain'}})
if(r.status>=300&&r.status<400&&r.headers.get('location')&&hops<3)return get(new URL(r.headers.get('location'),u).href,hops+1)
if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return{html:(await r.text()).slice(0,150000),url:u.href}}
async function robots(origin){try{const{html}=await get(origin+'/robots.txt');const rules=[];let on=false
for(const l of html.split('\n')){const m=l.split('#')[0].trim(),i=m.indexOf(':');if(i<0)continue;const k=m.slice(0,i).toLowerCase(),v=m.slice(i+1).trim();if(k==='user-agent')on=v==='*';else if(on&&k==='disallow'&&v)rules.push(v)}
return p=>!rules.some(r=>p.startsWith(r))}catch{return()=>true}}
const dom=u=>new URL(u).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'')
const strip=h=>h.replace(/<(script|style|noscript|svg)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/&nbsp;|&amp;/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()
const meta=(h,n)=>{const m=h.match(new RegExp(`<meta[^>]+(?:name|property)=["']${n}["'][^>]*>`,'i'));const c=m&&m[0].match(/content=["']([^"']*)["']/i);return c?c[1]:''}
const c=(k,ok,cat)=>({k,ok:!!ok,cat})
function analyse(html,url){const title=((html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i)||[])[1]||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,120),desc=meta(html,'description').slice(0,200)
const links=[...new Set([...html.matchAll(/<a[^>]+href=["']([^"'#]+)["']/gi)].map(m=>m[1]))].slice(0,200)
const soc=['instagram','facebook','youtube','linkedin','twitter','tiktok','pinterest'].filter(s=>links.some(l=>l.includes(s)))
const tech=/wp-content/.test(html)?'WordPress':/wixstatic|wix\.com/.test(html)?'Wix':/cdn\.shopify/.test(html)?'Shopify':/webflow/.test(html)?'Webflow':/squarespace/.test(html)?'Squarespace':'custom/unknown'
const checks=[c('HTTPS secure',url.startsWith('https'),'software'),c('Mobile friendly',/<meta[^>]+name=["']viewport/i.test(html),'software'),
c('Chatbot / live chat',/tawk\.to|intercom|crisp\.chat|tidio|drift|livechat|zendesk|wati|gupshup|botpress|chatbot/i.test(html),'software'),
c('WhatsApp button',/wa\.me|api\.whatsapp|whatsapp/i.test(html),'software'),c('Online booking',/calendly|booksy|setmore|book (now|a)|appointment/i.test(html),'software'),
c('Online payment / cart',/razorpay|stripe|paypal|payu|cashfree|add to cart|checkout/i.test(html),'software'),c('Lead / contact form',/<form/i.test(html),'software'),
c('SEO title + description',title.length>10&&desc,'marketing'),c('Clear H1 heading',/<h1/i.test(html),'marketing'),c('Social share tags',meta(html,'og:title'),'marketing'),
c('Structured data (schema)',/application\/ld\+json/.test(html),'marketing'),c('Analytics / pixels',/googletagmanager|google-analytics|gtag\(|fbq\(|connect\.facebook\.net/.test(html),'marketing'),c('Social profiles linked (2+)',soc.length>=2,'marketing')]
return{title,desc,tech,social:soc,checks,text:strip(html).slice(0,1400),links}}
async function tavily(q){const r=await fetch('https://api.tavily.com/search',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json',authorization:'Bearer '+E.TAVILY_KEY},body:JSON.stringify({query:q,max_results:5,search_depth:'basic'})})
if(!r.ok)return[];return((await r.json()).results||[]).map(x=>({title:x.title,url:x.url,snippet:(x.content||'').slice(0,280)}))}
async function groq(messages){for(const model of [E.GROQ_MODEL||'openai/gpt-oss-120b','llama-3.3-70b-versatile','llama-3.1-8b-instant']){
const r=await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json',authorization:'Bearer '+E.GROQ_KEY},
body:JSON.stringify({model,messages,temperature:.3,max_tokens:2400,...(model.includes('gpt-oss')?{reasoning_effort:'low'}:{}),response_format:{type:'json_object'}})})
if(r.ok){try{const t=(await r.json()).choices[0].message.content;return JSON.parse(t.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/)[0])}catch{}}}
throw new Error('AI is busy right now. Try again in a minute.')}
async function quota(fs,user,adm){const day=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),gk='usage/g_'+day,uk=`usage/${user.uid}_${day}`
const[g,u]=await Promise.all([fs.get(gk),fs.get(uk)]);const gn=g?.n||0,un=u?.n||0
if(!adm&&un>=3)return'You used your 3 free audits today. Try again tomorrow.';if(gn>=40)return'Free capacity for today is full. Try again tomorrow.'
await Promise.all([fs.set(gk,{n:gn+1}),fs.set(uk,{n:un+1})]);return null}

async function scout(req){const fs=FS();let jid
try{const tok=(req.headers.get('authorization')||'').replace('Bearer ','');const user=await verify(tok,fs.pid)
const adm=ADMINS.includes(user.email)&&user.verified;const b=await req.json()
let name=String(b.name||'').slice(0,100).trim(),link=String(b.link||'').slice(0,300).trim(),city=String(b.city||'').slice(0,60).trim()
if(!name&&!link)return{status:400,body:{error:'Enter a business name or link.'}}
if(link&&!/^https?:\/\//i.test(link))link='https://'+link
jid=/^[a-zA-Z0-9]{10,40}$/.test(b.jobId||'')?b.jobId:crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,'')
const input={name,link,city},path='scouts/'+jid,step=s=>fs.update(path,{step:s}).catch(()=>{})
if(link){try{const d=dom(link);const hit=(await fs.query('scouts',['domain',d],8)).filter(x=>x.status==='done'&&x.createdAt&&Date.now()-x.createdAt.getTime()<7*864e5).sort((x,y)=>y.createdAt-x.createdAt)[0]
if(hit){await fs.create('scouts',jid,{uid:user.uid,email:user.email,input,domain:d,status:'done',step:'Done',cached:true,checks:hit.checks,score:hit.score,report:hit.report,sources:hit.sources||[],createdAt:new Date()});return{body:{id:jid}}}}catch(e){if(/duplicate|409/i.test(e.message))throw e}}
const q=await quota(fs,user,adm);if(q)return{status:429,body:{error:q}}
await fs.create('scouts',jid,{uid:user.uid,email:user.email,input,status:'running',step:'Starting…',createdAt:new Date()})
let sources=[],snips=[],sig=null,pages=[],domain=''
if(!link){await step('Searching the web for the official website…');const r=await tavily(`${name} ${city} official website`);sources.push(...r.map(x=>x.url))
const f=r.find(x=>{try{return !SKIP.test(new URL(x.url).hostname)}catch{return false}});if(f)link=new URL(f.url).origin}
if(link){domain=dom(link);await step('Reading '+domain+'…');const o0=new URL(link),ok=await robots(o0.origin)
if(!ok(o0.pathname||'/'))throw new Error('This website asks bots not to read it (robots.txt). Respecting that.')
const home=await get(link);sig=analyse(home.html,home.url);pages.push(sig.text)
const o=new URL(home.url);const more=[...new Set(sig.links.map(l=>{try{return new URL(l,o).href}catch{return null}}).filter(l=>l&&new URL(l).origin===o.origin&&/about|team|contact|service|portfolio|work|product/i.test(l)))].slice(0,2)
for(const m of more){try{if(ok(new URL(m).pathname)){const p=await get(m);pages.push(strip(p.html.slice(0,60000)).slice(0,1000))}}catch{}}
sources.push(home.url)}
if(!name&&sig)name=sig.title
await step('Looking for public team and brand info…');snips=await tavily(`${name} ${city} founder owner team`);sources.push(...snips.map(x=>x.url))
await step('Matching with Kelvora network…')
const[bs,sv]=await Promise.all([fs.query('businesses',['verified',true],40),fs.query('services',null,20)])
const P=bs.filter(x=>!domain||!x.link||!x.link.includes(domain))
const checks=sig?sig.checks:[...['HTTPS secure','Mobile friendly','Chatbot / live chat','WhatsApp button','Online booking','Online payment / cart','Lead / contact form'].map(k=>c(k,false,'software')),...['SEO title + description','Clear H1 heading','Social share tags','Structured data (schema)','Analytics / pixels','Social profiles linked (2+)'].map(k=>c(k,false,'marketing'))]
const score=Math.round(100*checks.filter(x=>x.ok).length/checks.length)
await step('AI is writing the report…')
const rep=await groq([{role:'system',content:SYS},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({subject:{name,city,link:link||'NO WEBSITE FOUND',title:sig?.title,desc:sig?.desc,tech:sig?.tech,social:sig?.social,excerpt:pages.join(' | ').slice(0,3000)},passed:checks.filter(x=>x.ok).map(x=>x.k),missing:checks.filter(x=>!x.ok).map(x=>x.k),search:snips,
kelvora:{services:sv.map(d=>({title:d.title,category:d.category})),agents:AGENTS},partners:P.slice(0,25).map(x=>({id:x.id,name:x.name,category:x.category,about:(x.desc||'').slice(0,110)}))})}])
rep.partners=(rep.partners||[]).map(p=>{const x=P.find(y=>y.id===p.id);return x?{...p,name:x.name,category:x.category}:null}).filter(Boolean)
await fs.update(path,{status:'done',step:'Done',domain,checks,score,report:rep,sources:[...new Set(sources)].slice(0,10),cached:false})
return{body:{id:jid}}}catch(e){try{if(jid)await fs.update('scouts/'+jid,{status:'error',step:e.message})}catch{}
return{status:500,body:{error:e.message||'Failed'}}}}

export default{async fetch(req,env){E=env;const o=req.headers.get('origin')||'';const cors={'access-control-allow-origin':okOrigin(o)?o:ORIGINS[0],'access-control-allow-headers':'content-type,authorization','access-control-allow-methods':'POST,OPTIONS',vary:'origin'}
if(req.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{status:204,headers:cors})
if(req.method!=='POST')return new Response('Kelvora Scout API',{headers:cors})
const out=await scout(req).catch(e=>({status:500,body:{error:e.message||'Failed'}}))
return new Response(JSON.stringify(out.body),{status:out.status||200,headers:{...cors,'content-type':'application/json'}})}}
